thread:
Riley Moran: Quick brainstorm 1: want a compact 4-email micro-onboarding + invite funnel for webinar benchmark demo. Primary goal: get people to watch the 5-min benchmark demo or book a quick trial. Keep it low-friction. Thoughts?
Priya Shah: Good. Keep emails modular so we can reuse as nurture for webinar registrants vs new signups. Suggest control flow by intent tag at signup.
Ethan Brooks: Timing idea: Day 0 (welcome + 1-click demo), Day 2 (benchmark highlight + chart), Day 5 (how-to + quick snippet), Day 9 (webinar invite + social proof).
Nora Alvarez: Copy direction: punchy subject, mobile-first, single primary CTA per email. Example subjects: "5-min demo: see Redwood in action", "Cut inference cost by X% 1", "Live Q&A: behind the benchmark".
Zoe Kim: Segments: docs/OSS, trial, webinar-reg. Each gets slightly different lead magnet. For webinar-reg, include calendar add link. For trial cohort, emphasize "one-click start".
Riley Moran: A/B test idea: Variant 1 = benchmark-first (lead with numbers), Variant 2 = how-to-first (lead with quick setup). Run on the docs cohort.
Priya Shah: Tracking keys: utm_campaign=micro_onboard_q2, utm_medium=email, utm_term=variant1|variant2. Also push custom event `micro_onboard_demo_watch` with cohort tag.
Ethan Brooks: Ops checklist:
```
- Create 4 HTML templates (responsive)
- Build segment exports: docs, trial, webinar
- Add UTM macro to all links
- QA in staging domain
- Set retry rules for send failures
```
Nora Alvarez: For the Day-2 benchmark email, I'll include a small inline chart (SVG) + alt text. Zoe, confirm that SVG is <20KB for deliverability.
Zoe Kim: Confirmed 1 I'll optimize and inline. Also recommend we avoid attachments; host video as thumbnail linking to recording.
Riley Moran: Email cadence liftoff plan: dry run to 500 internal + VIP list, then gradual ramp to 10% of weekly signups for 48 hours. If open rate >35% and click>8%, continue rollout.
Priya Shah: Add rule: any clicked CTA from enterprise-domains should trigger a fast-path SDR alert (Slack + CRM). We'll add that to the handoff workflow.
Ethan Brooks: Quick send-tool commands for QA:
```
send-tool create-campaign --name "micro-onboard-q2" --from "Riley <riley@redwood.ai>"
send-tool schedule --campaign micro-onboard-q2 --dry-run --list staging-internal --at "2024-05-03T09:00:00-07:00"
```
Zoe Kim: Can someone schedule the dry run? I can QA images after templates are pushed.
send-bot: Dry run scheduled for 2024-05-03 09:00 PT to list staging-internal. Reminder set 15m prior.
Riley Moran: Perfect. Next: Nora will drop benchmark copy by EOD Tuesday, Priya will create segments and webhook to CRM, Ethan will push templates and run QA, Zoe will finalize assets. We'll sync after dry run for metrics and go/no-go ramp. :eyes:
